cgroup2 on /sys/fs/cgroup type cgroup2 (rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime,nsdelegate)
---
0::/
--- daemon ---
 Storage Driver: overlay2
 Logging Driver: json-file
 Cgroup Driver: cgroupfs
 Cgroup Version: 2
  cgroupns
--- pid1 ---
    PID COMMAND         COMMAND
      1 tini            /usr/bin/tini -- /usr/local/bin/installbench-dind-entrypoint sleep infinity

observation.command: mount | grep cgroup; echo "---"; cat /proc/1/cgroup; echo "--- daemon ---"; docker info 2>/dev/null | grep -i "cgroup\|driver"; echo "--- pid1 ---"; ps -p 1 -o pid,comm,args 2>/dev/null
